item.title: Re: Some famous PoIs?
item.content:encoded:
I would look over the personnel dossier if you haven't already.

My favourite of PoI is:
dado

dado is an eccentric parapharmocologist with a habit of misunderstanding his clients. he is known for his hampster and broken caps lock key (which makes all his writing in lowercase). famous for banana pills, astute political commentary and other shenanigans.

I also like Lord Blackwood, who is basically an English naturalist from the 19th century who got turned into a sea-slug.
